articles.title: A Systematic Review of New, Enhanced Surveillance Systems and Methodologies for Zoonotic Influenza Viruses in Animals and Human-Animal Interface.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

en.research_question: The authors aimed to evaluate recent developments in monitoring techniques for animal and cross-species influenza viruses to determine which innovations warrant broader application and which areas require further investigation.
en.study_design: This work follows a systematic review framework guided by PRISMA standards, synthesizing data from 164 selected publications out of an initial search yielding 7,490 records.
en.population_setting: The scope encompasses global efforts to track influenza strains circulating among wildlife, livestock, and humans, with particular attention to interaction zones where spillover events occur.
en.main_findings: The analysis identifies multiple technological improvements alongside persistent structural deficiencies in monitoring networks. Current documentation indicates that numerous regions operate without robust cross-sectoral tracking systems, resulting in incomplete estimates of infection prevalence. Priority actions emphasize integrating multi-sectoral datasets, standardizing new testing tools, scaling passive sampling strategies, and aligning technical upgrades with regulatory decision-making.
en.public_health_relevance: Strengthening coordinated monitoring frameworks is presented as essential for reducing seasonal illness impacts and mitigating future outbreak threats through improved diagnostic readiness and targeted research funding.
en.limitations: The evaluation relies exclusively on indexed academic publications, which may overlook operational field data or reflect uneven research investment across different geographic areas. Additionally, the focus on a seven-year window restricts historical context for long-term trend analysis.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication offers a consolidated perspective on methodological evolution within cross-species pathogen tracking initiatives. It contextualizes recent scholarly contributions toward standardized data collection and policy alignment without referencing active epidemiological dashboards or real-time transmission metrics.

articles.title: Intranasal and intramuscular H5-Matrix-M nanoparticle vaccines protects against highly pathogenic H5N1 influenza virus in mice
articles.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

en.research_question: The investigation evaluates whether a Matrix-M-adjuvanted nanoparticle vaccine can generate protective immune responses against an emerging H5N1 strain when delivered via nasal or injection routes.
en.study_design: A controlled animal experiment utilizing two mouse cohorts, one unexposed and one previously administered a seasonal influenza formulation, followed by targeted viral challenge.
en.population_setting: Laboratory mice subjected to either baseline conditions or prior seasonal influenza immunization before receiving the experimental nanoparticle construct.
en.main_findings: Both delivery methods triggered substantial antibody production and prevented mortality following lethal exposure. Previously immunized animals required only a single booster dose to achieve comparable defense, while nasal application resulted in lower viral detection within the upper respiratory tract compared to injections.
en.public_health_relevance: The data indicate that this adjuvanted nanoparticle approach may circumvent interference from existing seasonal influenza antibodies, highlighting its potential utility in pandemic response strategies.
en.limitations: Findings are restricted to murine models and do not account for human physiological differences, extended durability of protection, or adverse event profiling.
en.gids_interpretation: This record documents early-stage experimental work on a specific adjuvanted platform targeting an evolving avian influenza lineage, offering contextual background for monitoring vaccine innovation trajectories rather than active epidemiological tracking.

zh.main_findings: 两种接种途径均能激发显著的结合抗体与中和抗体反应，并有效抵御致死性H5N1病毒攻击。在已预免疫的小鼠中，鼻内给药在上呼吸道检测到的突破性感染数量少于肌内注射。

articles.title: Synergy between HA cleavage site sequence and NA-mediated plasminogen recruitment as a virulence mechanism for low-pathogenic avian influenza.

en.research_question: The investigation examines how specific amino acid variations in viral surface proteins influence the capacity of low-pathogenic avian influenza strains to trigger severe illness and disseminate within poultry hosts.
en.study_design: Researchers employed a reverse genetics platform to engineer wild-type and modified viral isolates, then evaluated their behavior across multiple avian cell cultures and chicken organoid models. Experimental validation extended to embryonic infection assays and computational screening of publicly available viral sequences.
en.population_setting: The primary isolate originated from poultry experiencing an unexplained mortality event in Belgium during 2019. Subsequent laboratory evaluations utilized diverse avian tissue lines, organotypic chicken models, and developing avian embryos.
en.main_findings: A distinct neuraminidase residue enables binding to host plasminogen, which collaborates with an unconventional hemagglutinin cleavage region to permit enzyme-independent viral activation. Introducing standard consensus sequences at these positions substantially diminished proteolytic processing, replication efficiency, and systemic distribution in laboratory models. Computational mapping identified additional circulating lineages harboring similar molecular signatures, indicating a wider pattern of unexpected virulence among otherwise mild strains.
en.public_health_relevance: Characterizing these protein interactions establishes a molecular baseline for evaluating the threat level of emerging avian influenza variants. Such insights may strengthen predictive modeling efforts aimed at safeguarding commercial poultry operations from sudden pathogenic shifts.
en.limitations: The experimental framework relies on engineered mutations and controlled laboratory environments that may not capture the full complexity of natural host immunity or environmental transmission routes. Consequently, observed replication patterns require further validation under field conditions.
en.gids_interpretation: The described molecular pathways highlight specific genetic markers that could theoretically inform future genomic tracking protocols. These findings offer a conceptual foundation for variant prioritization without implying integration into current operational monitoring systems.

zh.study_design: 采用反向遗传学技术构建单突变及双突变病毒株，结合多种禽类细胞系、鸡类类器官体外培养模型、鸡胚体内感染实验以及生物信息学序列分析进行综合验证。

articles.title: Transmission, Pathological and Clinical Manifestations of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A Virus in Mammals with Emphasis on H5N1 Clade 2.3.4.4b.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

en.research_question: This review investigates the transmission patterns, disease pathology, and clinical symptoms associated with highly pathogenic avian influenza A virus H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b in mammalian hosts, with particular attention to central nervous system involvement.
en.study_design: The authors performed a narrative review that synthesized previously documented case reports to characterize infection patterns across distinct mammalian categories.
en.population_setting: The analysis focuses on naturally infected terrestrial wildlife, marine species, and dairy cattle, with documented cross-species spillover events concentrated in European and American regions.
en.main_findings: Clinical presentations vary by host group, showing respiratory and neurological symptoms in marine animals alongside lethargy and neurological deficits in land-dwelling species. Tissue damage predominantly targets the lungs and brain in wildlife, whereas gastrointestinal and mammary structures are primarily affected in livestock. Elevated viral concentrations within neural tissue highlight a strong neurological preference, while emerging observations suggest possible direct animal-to-animal and parent-to-offspring spread.
en.public_health_relevance: The demonstrated capacity for cross-species infection and potential intermammalian transmission highlights ongoing risks for human exposure and reinforces the importance of systematic monitoring to track viral evolution in animal reservoirs.
en.limitations: The precise biological mechanisms enabling central nervous system entry remain unverified, with several theoretical pathways still under discussion. Furthermore, the conclusions rely entirely on compiled observational reports rather than controlled experimental investigations.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication situates cross-species viral ecology within broader One Health frameworks by cataloging host-specific disease signatures and highlighting the scientific value of coordinated tracking systems for emerging infectious agents.

zh.study_design: 该文献属于同行评议的综述文章，通过归纳现有病例报告来总结特定病毒株在不同哺乳动物类群中的感染规律。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象主要来源于欧洲与美洲地区报告的多种自然感染哺乳动物，按生态习性划分为陆生动物、海洋哺乳动物及奶牛三大类别。
zh.main_findings: 临床观察显示海洋哺乳动物常出现神经与呼吸道症状，陆生动物以神经异常和嗜睡为主，奶牛则主要表现为胃肠道与乳腺病变。免疫组化与分子检测证实脑组织内病毒载量显著升高，提示该毒株具备较强的神经趋向性。此外，文中记录了哺乳动物间传播及垂直传播的相关证据。

articles.title: Biosecurity Uptake and Perceived Risk of Avian Influenza Among People in Contact With Birds.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

en.research_question: What are the current adoption rates of protective practices and how do individuals involved in avian husbandry perceive zoonotic disease threats?
en.study_design: A cross-sectional survey utilizing standardized questionnaires administered over a three-month period.
en.population_setting: Two hundred twenty-five respondents located in the United Kingdom who maintain regular contact with poultry or other avian species.
en.main_findings: Post-contact hand cleaning emerged as the predominant safety protocol, followed by the use of chemical footbaths. Daily interactions with larger bird counts increased the likelihood of employing various protective gear categories. While concerns regarding viral impacts on animal welfare were pronounced, especially among large-scale operators, apprehension about personal infection remained uniformly low across all participant groups.
en.public_health_relevance: The observed gap between routine animal-focused protocols and human-directed precautions suggests opportunities for targeted educational outreach. Understanding these behavioral patterns can help shape communication strategies that address specific compliance obstacles within high-exposure demographics.
en.limitations: Reliance on self-reported survey responses from a single geographic region may introduce reporting bias and limit broader applicability.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication supplies foundational behavioral metrics and awareness benchmarks useful for contextualizing avian influenza preparedness discussions within academic and policy literature. It functions as a static reference point for tracking historical compliance trends rather than indicating active epidemiological monitoring or real-time threat escalation.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在调查英国接触鸟类人群的生物安全措施采用情况及其对禽流感的风险认知，重点关注预防跨物种传播的相关实践。
zh.study_design: 该研究采用横断面问卷调查设计，于2024年5月至7月期间收集数据。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象为英国境内225名日常与鸟类存在接触的人员。
zh.main_findings: 接触鸟类后洗手是最普遍的措施，其次为鞋底消毒。接触鸟类数量越多，使用个人防护装备的概率越高。受访者普遍认为禽流感对禽类健康威胁较大，但对其自身健康风险认知较低，表明现有措施主要侧重于控制禽间传播而非人畜共患。
zh.public_health_relevance: 结果揭示了当前生物安全实践在阻断人畜共患传播方面的局限性，提示公共卫生部门需针对特定人群制定干预策略，以改善防护措施的实际应用效果。
zh.limitations: 研究依赖自我报告问卷且样本局限于单一国家，横断面设计难以确立因果关系或评估行为的长期演变。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献从同一健康视角补充了禽流感人畜共患传播链中的人类行为学数据，有助于完善相关疾病传播动力学模型中的风险认知维度。

articles.title: Transmission Pathways of Zoonotic Influenza Viruses and Influencing Factors: A Systematic Review of Recent Findings.

en.research_question: This systematic review synthesizes recent literature to identify how zoonotic influenza viruses move between animal populations and spill over into human communities, alongside the variables that facilitate these cross-species transfers.
en.study_design: The authors conducted a systematic review adhering to PRISMA standards, screening thousands of database records to select relevant publications spanning seven years.
en.population_setting: The analysis encompasses studies involving wild and domestic animal reservoirs, as well as human populations affected by cross-species viral transfer, without restricting geographic boundaries.
en.main_findings: The synthesis highlights existing knowledge on host, environmental, and viral drivers of transmission while revealing substantial unexplored areas regarding interspecies movement, ecological influences, and regional zoonotic risks.
en.public_health_relevance: Clarifying these transmission mechanisms supports improved pandemic preparedness and underscores the importance of coordinated, multi-sectoral health frameworks to mitigate future spillover threats.
en.limitations: The authors acknowledge that the reviewed corpus contains notable gaps, specifically regarding viral circulation across varied animal hosts, the precise influence of ecological variables, and regional variations in cross-species risk.
en.gids_interpretation: This work situates ongoing academic inquiry into viral ecology within established international research priorities, offering a consolidated reference point for scholars tracking cross-species pathogen movement.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在系统梳理2017年至2024年间关于人畜共患流感病毒传播途径及相关影响因素的文献，以明确跨物种传播的关键机制。
zh.study_design: 该研究遵循PRISMA指南开展系统评价，从PubMed初筛的7490篇记录中严格筛选出219篇文献进行综合分析。
zh.population_setting: 研究聚焦于野生与家养动物群体中的流感病毒传播，以及病毒跨越物种屏障感染人类的潜在过程。
zh.main_findings: 综述归纳了宿主行为、生态环境与病毒特性共同作用于传播网络的现有证据。分析表明，当前在复杂动物间传播链、环境变量量化影响及跨区域人畜共患风险图谱方面仍缺乏充分数据。
zh.public_health_relevance: 完善上述知识缺口有助于制定更精准的防控预案，并推动将多部门协同的健康管理框架纳入公共卫生规划。
zh.limitations: 作者直接指出，现有文献在阐明多样化动物宿主间的传播规律、解析环境因子的独立作用以及评估不同地域的跨种感染可能性上存在明显局限。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献系统整理了近年来的学术探讨，为理解人畜共患流感的传播机制演变提供了背景脉络，适合作为领域知识检索与主题定位的参考资料。

articles.title: Responding to avian influenza in poultry farms in Victoria, Australia.
articles.journal: Bulletin of the World Health Organization

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

en.research_question: The article investigates how coordinated public health agencies addressed human exposure risks following an avian influenza outbreak in Australian poultry operations.
en.study_design: This publication presents an observational outbreak investigation that utilized contact tracing, laboratory diagnostics, and public health intervention monitoring across multiple agricultural sites.
en.population_setting: The analysis centers on human associates linked to eight commercial poultry facilities situated within two shires in Victoria, Australia.
en.main_findings: Investigators documented 212 distinct individuals connected to the affected farms, spanning twenty-five municipalities. Laboratory screening revealed that none of the twenty evaluated suspected infections harbored influenza A. Administrative records indicated that roughly one-fifth of at-risk persons obtained antiviral treatment while slightly over a quarter received routine immunization.
en.public_health_relevance: The publication underscores the necessity for enhanced interagency cooperation and expanded preventive healthcare access to manage future zoonotic spillover events effectively.
en.limitations: The authors acknowledge existing deficiencies in preventive healthcare delivery and recommend broader systemic improvements across governmental tiers. Furthermore, the descriptive methodology restricts the evaluation of specific intervention outcomes.
en.gids_interpretation: This document offers historical context regarding coordinated veterinary and medical interventions during a specific regional poultry pathogen event. It functions as an archival reference for past operational frameworks without suggesting current epidemiological activity.

zh.research_question: 探讨澳大利亚维多利亚州禽类养殖场发生高致病性禽流感疫情时的多部门公共卫生应急响应模式。
zh.study_design: 本研究采用描述性方法，对单次禽流感暴发事件的追踪监测与联合处置流程进行回顾性总结。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象涵盖澳大利亚维多利亚州八个感染场所周边的二百一十二名人类接触者，其居住地分散于二十五个地方政府辖区。
zh.main_findings: 经实验室检测，二十名疑似病例均未检出甲型流感病毒。公共卫生团队实施了疫苗接种、抗病毒药物预防及主动监测等措施，整体响应被视为有效，但预防保健环节仍有改进空间。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该报告强调了跨层级政府、农业部门与卫生机构协同作战的重要性，为完善区域传染病预警机制及优化预防性资源配置提供了实践依据。
zh.limitations: 研究仅基于单一疫情事件展开描述，未设置对照比较；同时明确指出当前各级别间的应急准备策略尚存短板，且基层预防性医疗服务覆盖不足。
zh.gids_interpretation: 本文聚焦于动物源性传染病的现场调查与多机构联动响应，可作为理解特定地理区域内公共卫生危机管理框架的背景文献，有助于拓展相关主题的知识检索语境。

articles.title: Based on the MaxEnt model the analysis of influencing factors and simulation of potential risk areas of human infection with avian influenza A (H7N9) in China.
articles.journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology

related_surveillance.method: high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage
high-confidence article geography intersected with GIDS series coverage

en.research_question: The study seeks to identify environmental and demographic drivers associated with human H7N9 infections and to map historical risk zones across China.
en.study_design: Researchers applied a MaxEnt computational framework to analyze case locations alongside environmental and socioeconomic datasets spanning five years.
en.population_setting: The analysis focused on human cases reported throughout China, with particular attention to coastal provinces during the 2013 through 2017 timeframe.
en.main_findings: Model outputs indicate a steady annual escalation in infection probability, consistently highlighting eastern and southeastern coastal regions as persistent hotspots. Demographic concentration served as the strongest predictor, while ecological and agricultural metrics provided secondary explanatory power. Simulated risk distributions demonstrated strong agreement with documented outbreak locations.
en.public_health_relevance: Mapping these spatial trends and variable contributions may help guide resource allocation for targeted monitoring and intervention planning.
en.limitations: The authors acknowledge that expanding the dataset with additional variables is necessary to enhance predictive precision and strengthen policy guidance.
en.gids_interpretation: This work functions as a retrospective geospatial assessment that contextualizes historical H7N9 distribution patterns and their associated correlates, rather than providing an active monitoring mechanism.

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在探讨中国人群感染禽流感A(H7N9)病毒的相关影响因素及其传播特征，并评估潜在的高风险地理区域。
zh.study_design: 该研究采用MaxEnt算法进行回顾性空间建模，利用2013至2017年的病例点位与环境及社会经济数据进行相关性检验。
zh.population_setting: 研究聚焦于中国境内报告过H7N9确诊病例的地理范围，时间跨度覆盖2013年至2017年。
zh.main_findings: 模型模拟显示疫情风险呈逐年上升态势，东部与东南部沿海地带持续处于高风险区间。人口密度被识别为核心关联变量，植被覆盖、降水、海拔、家禽屠宰规模、产值及气温等亦为次要相关因素。模拟生成的风险分布图与实际疫情记录高度吻合。
zh.public_health_relevance: 明确关键关联变量与高风险地理分布可为公共卫生部门优化监测网络布局及资源配置提供科学参考。
zh.limitations: 作者明确指出当前模型纳入的变量集较为有限，未来需补充更多参数以提升预测精度并增强对防控策略的指导价值。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文提供的是基于历史数据的回顾性空间风险评估背景信息，侧重于环境与社会经济变量的关联性分析，未涉及实时监测信号的直接验证或前瞻性预警。

articles.title: Role and Contribution of Serological Surveillance in Animals and Exposed Humans to the Study of Zoonotic Influenza Disease Epidemiology: A Scoping Review.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

zh.research_question: 该综述旨在梳理2017年至2024年间全球关于动物及暴露人群血清学监测的研究现状，并评估其在人畜共患流感流行病学研究中的作用与方法进展。
zh.study_design: 研究采用范围综述设计，遵循PRISMA-ScR指南检索PubMed数据库，纳入2017年1月至2024年3月发表的相关英文同行评审文献。
zh.population_setting: 纳入数据涵盖33个国家的25种动物物种，其中家禽与生猪的血清学调查最为集中，同时涉及部分伴侣动物、野生哺乳动物及职业暴露人类群体。
zh.main_findings: 最终筛选出90项符合条件的研究，结果显示跨物种传播界面及非经济动物的监测资料相对匮乏。新兴的多重检测与纳米抗体技术虽具应用潜力，但在实际部署中仍面临操作与推广障碍。
zh.public_health_relevance: 将血清学监测更深度地整合至“同一健康”策略中，有望强化高风险区域与人兽交界地的早期预警能力与大流行防范准备。
zh.limitations: 本综述仅依赖单一电子数据库且限定英文文献，未开展正式的质量评价，且纳入的各项研究之间存在显著的异质性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献系统归纳了现有血清学监测研究的地理与物种分布特征，揭示了当前数据覆盖的盲区，可为后续监测网络优化提供背景参考，但不代表实时疫情追踪结果。

en.research_question: The authors sought to catalog worldwide research on antibody tracking for zoonotic influenza across animal reservoirs and at-risk human cohorts over a seven-year period.
en.study_design: A systematic scoping review was conducted using PRISMA-ScR protocols to evaluate peer-reviewed literature indexed in PubMed.
en.population_setting: Eligible records covered thirty-three nations and documented twenty-five distinct animal taxa, with particular emphasis on agricultural livestock and workers with direct animal contact.
en.main_findings: Analysis of ninety qualifying papers demonstrated that current antibody monitoring predominantly targets poultry and pigs, leaving wildlife and companion species significantly understudied. While advanced testing formats such as multiplex and nanobody assays emerged, practical adoption continues to encounter operational hurdles.
en.public_health_relevance: Expanding antibody-based monitoring programs across interconnected health sectors may improve early identification of cross-species viral circulation and strengthen global outbreak readiness.
en.limitations: The authors note that restricting searches to one repository, excluding non-English works, omitting formal study quality evaluation, and encountering high methodological diversity constrain the review's comprehensiveness.
en.gids_interpretation: This work functions as a bibliometric and methodological inventory of historical antibody tracking initiatives for avian and swine influenza, offering context on regional coverage and technical evolution without referencing active outbreak monitoring.

articles.title: Influenza vaccine effectiveness in Ireland during two influenza seasons, 2022/23 and 2023/24

en.research_question: What is the protective capacity of seasonal immunization against primary care visits for laboratory-confirmed influenza-associated respiratory illness in Ireland across the 2022/23 and 2023/24 periods?
en.study_design: Researchers applied a test-negative case-control framework operating inside a country-wide primary care monitoring system to contrast immunization records between PCR-positive patients and PCR-negative individuals presenting with comparable respiratory complaints.
en.population_setting: The analysis focused on individuals seeking outpatient care for acute respiratory symptoms in Ireland, with specific attention to pediatric cohorts and adults meeting established age or clinical risk criteria.
en.main_findings: Immunization showed moderate protection against clinic attendance for influenza-linked respiratory conditions, yielding point estimates between thirty-seven and forty-two percent for the broader group and climbing to sixty-seven percent among younger participants during the second evaluated period.
en.public_health_relevance: Sustaining routine immunization initiatives appears capable of reducing outpatient utilization for influenza-related illnesses, with notably stronger protective signals observed when administering live attenuated formulations to school-aged youth.
en.limitations: The reliance on a targeted primary care monitoring network may restrict broader demographic representation, while several subgroup confidence intervals displayed considerable width or included null values.
en.gids_interpretation: This report supplies seasonal efficacy metrics that may function as contextual benchmarks for evaluating regional immunization programs, without establishing real-time detection thresholds or operational surveillance triggers.

articles.journal: MMWR. Morbidity and mortality weekly report

zh.research_question: 本研究聚焦于美国后院家禽饲养人群对禽流感的认知水平、心理态度及日常防护实践。
zh.study_design: 研究团队通过线上问卷形式开展横断面调查，数据采集期为2025年下半年。
zh.population_setting: 共纳入638名有效受访者，主体为高学历白人非拉丁裔群体，主要饲养规模较小的鸡群。
zh.main_findings: 多数参与者知晓禽流感名称，但近三分之一无法识别人畜感染迹象。面对病亡禽类，大部分人掌握标准防护流程并倾向使用防护装备。同时，野外鸟类频繁进入饲养区的情况较为普遍。
zh.public_health_relevance: 数据揭示了该群体在疾病识别与防护执行方面的潜在缺口，为制定定向科普策略提供了依据。
zh.limitations: 基于自愿参与的在线调查可能引入应答偏倚，且样本背景较为单一，限制了结论的广泛适用性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该报告补充了特定养殖场景下的行为学基线资料，可作为后续风险评估模型中人群特征变量的参考来源。
